title: Swimming in rivers and lakes
question: Can I swim in rivers and lakes in Poland?
short_answer: Swimming is only officially safe at designated bathing areas (kąpieliska). Other spots carry risks.
conditions: Designated bathing areas (kąpieliska) are tested for water quality and have lifeguards
Swimming outside designated areas is not prohibited by national law but may be banned locally
Pay attention to warning signs (ZAKAZ KĄPIELI = bathing prohibited)
Blue-green algae blooms (sinice) periodically close beaches — check local authorities
exceptions: Some municipalities allow swimming in rivers in designated spots without official kąpielisko status
Wild swimming is popular in many areas but always check local signs
penalties: Fine: up to 500 PLN for swimming in a designated prohibition zone
If a lifeguard issues a warning and you ignore it, police may be called
